apps.name: Folio
apps.description: Your receipts and invoices, organized into a clear picture of spending.
apps.importGoal: Find receipts, paid purchases, refunds and unpaid invoice notices from email. Separate unpaid invoices and uncertain amounts from actual spending. Preserve source evidence and currencies. Exclude newsletters and promotional offers.

apps.name: Atlas
apps.description: Turn bookings and calendar plans into a beautiful travel journal.
apps.importGoal: Find actual travel reservations, flights and stays plus calendar travel plans. Use travel dates, not email dates. Merge evidence for the same journey. Keep tentative plans distinct from paid bookings and cancellations. Leave unknown flight times blank.

apps.name: Agenda
apps.description: A considered daily view of events, places, and priorities.
apps.importGoal: Read calendar events in the selected date range, keeping the original timezone and all-day semantics. Preserve event identifiers and calendar evidence.

apps.name: Follow-ups
apps.description: Keep promises and open conversations from slipping through the cracks.
apps.importGoal: Find explicit follow-up commitments and unanswered actionable conversations. Preserve who owes whom a response. Do not infer commitments from promotional messages. Never send replies.

apps.name: Subscriptions
apps.description: See recurring payments and renewal dates without hunting through email.
apps.importGoal: Find recurring providers, original amount/currency and cadence from selected email bodies. Record renewal-date and cancel-by only when explicitly stated, renewal-certainty Confirmed/Estimated/Unknown, retain uncertainty and source evidence. Never cancel subscriptions or claim cancellation. Preserve owner edits and report incomplete coverage.

apps.name: Deliveries
apps.description: Orders, tracking references, and delivery dates in one tidy place.
apps.importGoal: Extract real purchase confirmations and shipment updates. Merge messages for the same order and preserve the latest supported delivery status. Never invent delivery dates.

apps.name: Reading Library
apps.description: A personal shelf for articles and documents you want to return to.
apps.importGoal: Collect explicitly saved or shared reading material and relevant Drive documents in the selected range. Avoid importing an entire mailbox or Drive. Preserve original links and authors when known.

apps.name: People
apps.description: Remember the people, context, and next conversations that matter.
apps.importGoal: Propose reviewed individual contact records and dated interactions from selected email bodies and calendar events. Avoid automated senders. Retain identity/source evidence; do not merge people solely by display name. Record last-contact only from an actual dated source, keep next-contact owner-entered and outreach as drafts. Never send messages or copy sensitive full bodies.

apps.name: Files
apps.description: An organized index of important documents with links back to Drive.
apps.tagline: Find it when you need it.
apps.importGoal: Index relevant Drive documents using metadata and accessible content only. Preserve original links, document IDs and modified dates. Do not move or delete Drive files.

apps.name: Notes
apps.description: A quiet place to capture thoughts and keep useful notes.
apps.importGoal: This is a local notes app. No integration import is required. Create notes only from owner-provided content.

apps.name: Habits
apps.description: Track small daily rituals and see the consistency build.
apps.importGoal: This is a local habit tracker. Add habits and check-ins only from owner-provided content.

apps.name: Focus
apps.description: A focused timer and a record of time spent on meaningful work.
apps.importGoal: This is a local focus timer and session log. Record only real completed sessions or owner-provided entries.

apps.name: Cashflow
apps.description: Track incoming invoices, due dates, and payment evidence.
apps.tagline: A clear view of what is owed.
apps.importGoal: Find sent client invoices and explicitly stated due dates, amount, currency, payment evidence and exceptions from selected email bodies. Unknown due dates stay empty; distinguish Partial, Disputed, Externally paid and Paid using evidence, not silence or estimates. Keep reminder-draft as a reviewable draft only, never send or move money. Preserve owner corrections. For a selected Stripe account use restricted invoice/customer reads and original invoice status, amount_paid and due_date. Choose live or test account explicitly. Recheck source payment status before any later approved reminder.

apps.name: Revenue
apps.description: A readable ledger of invoices and payments from your billing account.
apps.importGoal: Read Stripe invoices and payment intents. Deduplicate payments linked to invoices, use actual settlement status, and convert minor units correctly per currency. Do not combine currencies or treat pending funds as revenue.

apps.name: Pipeline
apps.description: Manage real opportunities with context from conversations.
apps.importGoal: Find explicit commercial opportunities and agreed next steps from work email. Keep amounts and stages evidence-based. Never send messages or infer deals from general newsletters.

apps.name: Projects
apps.description: Bring active projects and issues into a focused delivery board.
apps.importGoal: Read only the selected Linear projects and issues. Retain issue URLs, status, assignee, explicit due-date and source-updated timestamps. Derive risk from known blocked/overdue/stale facts; mark missing evidence uncertain. Never infer deployment or approval from a resolved ticket. Produce a source-grounded reviewable risk brief, never change tickets.

apps.name: Meeting Briefs
apps.description: Prepare for meetings with relevant calendar and conversation context.
apps.importGoal: Read upcoming calendar meetings and relevant email threads for those meetings only. Separate source facts from suggested preparation. Do not invent meeting outcomes or send invitations.

apps.name: Support
apps.description: Organize customer requests and the next response needed.
apps.importGoal: Find genuine customer support requests from selected work accounts or channels. Deduplicate cross-posted requests and preserve source evidence. Never send replies or mark source conversations resolved.

apps.name: Hiring
apps.description: Candidates, interview dates, and hiring context in a clear board.
apps.importGoal: Find actual candidate applications and interviews. Keep factual role, interview date and candidate-provided context. Never infer protected traits, rank candidates, or send outreach.

apps.name: Company Spend
apps.description: Track work purchases and recurring vendor costs with evidence.
apps.importGoal: Extract business receipts and supplier invoices from explicitly selected work inboxes. Separate paid expenses, unpaid invoices and refunds. Preserve currencies and source IDs; do not include personal inboxes without explicit selection.

apps.name: Releases
apps.description: Follow pull requests and delivery work across your product.
apps.tagline: From work in progress to shipped.
apps.importGoal: Read selected GitHub repositories, pull requests and Linear issues. Require a specific repository/project before deep import. Mark shipped only when merged/released evidence exists. Do not create or change issues or PRs.

apps.name: Knowledge
apps.description: A shared-purpose index of the documents your work depends on.
apps.importGoal: Index selected Notion pages and Drive documents using supported read actions. Preserve access boundaries and original links. This app stores an owner-local index, not a new organization-wide permission scope.

apps.name: Campaigns
apps.description: Keep campaign plans, assets, and delivery stages together.
apps.importGoal: Collect explicitly identified campaign plans and campaign-related Slack discussions. Preserve actual stage, dates and asset links. Do not infer publishing completion or publish posts.

apps.name: Analytics
apps.description: Save source-supported product observations and their next actions.
apps.importGoal: Read selected PostHog project insights and supported read-only queries within the chosen date range. Preserve insight IDs, query date ranges and original project links. Store actual observed metrics only; do not fabricate trends, compare incompatible definitions, or call unsupported actions. Leave unavailable values empty and report coverage.

apps.name: Workout History Coach
apps.description: See your progress, one working set at a time. Log sets, compare volume and keep your own training history.
apps.importGoal: Use owner-entered completed training sets only. Distinguish warmups from working sets; do not give medical or injury advice.
highlights: Your records, saved in your computer
Designed for your phone and computer

apps.name: Paycheck Runway
apps.description: Give every bill a place before the next payday. Plan confirmed income and commitments without guessing your bank balance.
apps.importGoal: Only owner-confirmed opening cash, income, bills and reserves. Estimates remain outside confirmed runway. Keep currencies separate; do not infer balances from mail or claim bank access.
highlights: Your records, saved in your computer
Designed for your phone and computer

apps.name: Meal Rotation & Grocery Plan
apps.description: Save the recipes you like, plan portions and turn the week into one practical grocery list.
apps.importGoal: Use owner-owned recipes and pantry quantities. Preserve ingredients and units; never guarantee nutrition or allergy safety or perform checkout.
highlights: Your records, saved in your computer
Designed for your phone and computer

apps.name: Job Search Companion
apps.description: A calmer place for applications, interviews and the next step. Keep confirmed updates beside your own plans.
apps.importGoal: Read only bounded application confirmations and interview messages from selected email bodies. Extract role/company, explicitly confirmed stage, local interview date/time/time zone and source evidence. Do not infer acceptance or rejection from silence. Keep resume and next-step owner-edited; draft outreach only, never send.
highlights: Your records, saved in your computer
Designed for your phone and computer

apps.name: Study From My Notes
apps.description: Turn your own notes into editable, source-backed questions. Practice recall and return to what needs another look.
apps.tagline: Make what you read stay with you.
apps.importGoal: Read only the exact owner-selected Google Docs document IDs from source context. Retain bounded text and exact supporting quotes. Propose five editable study questions and answers grounded in the actual source; reject unsupported quotes. No PDF OCR or Notion content claims. Preserve corrected answers and recall state.
highlights: Your records, saved in your computer
Designed for your phone and computer

apps.name: Journal That Remembers
apps.description: A private place to write, revisit themes and remember the decisions that mattered. You choose what is included.
apps.importGoal: Analyze only the owner-selected period and explicitly included private entries. Cite supporting entry IDs and exact excerpts, honor corrections/exclusions, and distinguish reported events from interpretations. No therapy, diagnosis or automatic sharing.
highlights: Your records, saved in your computer
Designed for your phone and computer

apps.name: Chess Practice Coach
apps.description: Revisit a completed game, inspect legal moves and practice a position using bounded local chess analysis.
apps.importGoal: Use only owner-provided completed PGNs. Never analyze live games or fabricate engine results. Local search must validate legal positions, expose its search depth and bound resources.
highlights: Your records, saved in your computer
Designed for your phone and computer
